beliefs: Every lowercase letter is shifted backward by one in the alphabet (a->z, b->a, ..., z->y) [E1, E2, E3, E4, E5, E6]
Every uppercase letter is shifted backward by one in the alphabet (A->Z, B->A, ..., Z->Y) [E1, E2, E3]
Non-letter characters (digits, spaces, symbols) are left unchanged [E1, E6]
The shift applies to all letters in the string, not just the first [E4, E5, E6]
